decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter sits close to the core range and fits the firm's push into organic lines, so keeping it open costs little while its value is still uncertain, though its mere mention on the website suggests weaker prominence.

Organic poultry mini salami snacks get their own page and match the strategic expansion into organic and new formats, and one year is too early to resolve uncertainty, so the low-cost option is worth holding.

The premium sharing snack is close to established salami capabilities and is prominently presented, so with low carrying costs and unresolved prospects in a growing market it remains a worthwhile option to keep.
